entries.intervention: Revoke the selected effective right on the target, including every contributing ACE and inheritance origin.
limitations: Removing one ACE is insufficient when another grant or group remains.
Derived rights can be recreated by other retained rights; rerun from the initial state.
entries.title: Revoke effective object control

entries.intervention: Remove effective host administrative authorization for the selected principal.
limitations: AdminTo is not proof of a specific remote protocol.
Existing initial admin_control is outside this intervention.
entries.title: Remove effective host administration

entries.intervention: Deny the modeled privileged execution channel for the exact actor and host.
limitations: The abstract gate cannot be labeled WinRM-only or RDP-only.
Separate runtime bindings are needed for each affected actor.
required_evidence: verified channel policy or declared counterfactual rationale
entries.title: Restrict privileged execution channel

entries.intervention: Remove exact membership, recompute nested entitlement from initial state after declared token refresh.
limitations: Already effective initial token membership is not revoked automatically.
Membership additions can restore a route if modification rights remain.
entries.title: Remove security group entitlement

entries.intervention: Clear DONT_REQ_PREAUTH for the User; effective counterfactual dontreqpreauth=false.
limitations: Existing AS-REP material or recovered passwords in the initial state survive.
Runtime facts cannot override this snapshot gate.
entries.title: Require Kerberos preauthentication

entries.intervention: Remove all relevant servicePrincipalName registrations only for a genuinely decommissioned service; effective has_spn=false and service_principal_names=[].
limitations: Deleting a required SPN can break a service and is not the default roasting fix.
Partial SPN removal may leave an opportunity; existing tickets survive.
required_evidence: known SPN list and has_spn evidence
service ownership and decommission approval rationale
entries.title: Decommission an unnecessary service registration

entries.intervention: Use stronger managed secrets where supported; rerate exact recovery method/budget/horizon.
limitations: Hardening alone cannot prove recovery_success=false or P=0.
No numeric adoption is performed in this package.
required_evidence: reviewed recovery basis in new context
entries.title: Strengthen or manage service/account secrets

entries.intervention: Deny exact descriptor write on the resource account after verifying effective rights.
limitations: Removing only the current delegation descriptor is ineffective if the attacker can write it again.
Canonical M1 does not expose a dedicated descriptor-write edge; do not invent one.
Current RBCD exact-right gate consumes observed GenericAll only; WriteDacl-derived rights are not supported by that gate.
entries.title: Revoke effective RBCD descriptor write

entries.intervention: Deny the bound service/impersonated identity/resource delegation policy.
limitations: Cleanup of PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount must also address write-back authority.
Preexisting delegated contexts require separate lifecycle modeling.
required_evidence: delegation policy evidence or conditional declaration
entries.title: Restrict delegated service authorization

entries.intervention: End the exact user session on its observed source host, making session_present=false.
limitations: Static observation remains unchanged.
Already acquired credential_material survives and is not currently a password activation producer.
entries.title: End the relevant privileged session

entries.intervention: Establish protection sufficient for the modeled useful material and set credential_accessible=false only with scoped validation.
limitations: Credential Guard is not a universal boolean cure: service tickets and some credential forms are outside its protection.
No automatic protection or material-reuse claim.
entries.title: Prevent access to useful session credential material
